name: qwen3.8-27b

commands.test_answer: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt": "What is the capital of France?", "n_predict": 50}'
commands.test_think: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt": "Solve this step by step: If a train travels 60km in 1 hour, how far does it travel in 2.5 hours?", "n_predict": 200}'
commands.test_tool: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt": "Call the weather function for London with temperature unit celsius", "n_predict": 100}'
commands.test_recall: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt": "<|begin_of_text|>" + "Once upon a time there was a very long story... " * 500 + "What was the main character's name?", "n_predict": 50}'

notes: Optimized for RX 9070 XT 16GB / RX 7600 XT 16GB / RX 6800 XT 16GB with Qwen3.8-27B IQ3_S quantization supporting 128K context
